items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: And then Paul Santon was a guitar player, well he taught them, there was about six of them.

ctx.x: Well we're thinking of other people over there, did you ever...

I'll tell you who I did see over there, there was a man by the name of Professor Divergis. He was something like pinch back at that time, would go around teaching youngsters that didn't quite have enough means to go to school. And they had another group of fellas in Madisonville, it was Joe Clark who played the violin, his daddy played the bass, and Joe, let's see what this guy's name, he was a high school, he played trombone. And then Paul Santon was a guitar player, well he taught them, there was about six of…
The Voidners taught mostly scholars for nothing.
